recorded.prompt:q-dominated: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-dominated: the answer is the frontier: plans where no other plan has both more NPV and more risk removed ... then drops any point another point dominates
